description: ClickHouse's spec marks no response member required, so ClickPipe.id is optional, and a caller must handle a createClickPipe answer without the new pipe's ID. It is always present: Alchemy's ClickHouse Cloud provider created a ClickPipe, waited on it, renamed it and deleted it by the `id` createClickPipe returned (live, 2026-11-12), and ClickHouse's Terraform provider (ClickHouse/terraform-provider-clickhouse at 66ecf4fa, internal/api) waits on and stores that `id` right after the create. Marking ClickPipe.id required lets callers read the ID without checking for undefined.
